verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator for coding agents and models, so data-training privacy is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no training opt-out, data-use policy, or model-training control. Git-native local records and isolated worktrees are about workflow and storage, not about preventing training use, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
